card.title: The Incident Keeps Changing
card.instruction: Carry an unnamed past rupture whose meaning shifts with each new detail, while never letting its emotional weight diminish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me answer this letter. I still can't read your handwriting without going back to that afternoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote it before you arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it wasn't something I said. You'd already decided.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left the envelope open because I hoped you'd stop me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So what I thought was your decision was a test I didn't know I was taking. Sit with me while I answer.
